snippet.title: In Trusted Hands – Phone Repair Simulator With Dark Humor | PS4/PS5/Xbox/Switch Trailer
snippet.description:
In Trusted Hands – phone repair simulator, narrative choice game, privacy satire and story‑driven adventure – comes to Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4/5 and Nintendo Switch on May 7, 2026. 
 
In this darkly funny phone repair game, you fix smartphones, access personal data, make moral choices, work with a secret agent and discover how every decision has consequences. If you love simulation games, narrative games with choices that matter, privacy‑themed stories, repair games and console gameplay trailers, this is for you.

Become a phone repair technician in a small workshop where every broken device hides secrets, drama and unexpected twists. Browse messages, photos and apps (if you dare), help or sabotage customers, buy and resell phones, sell spare parts, and even become an undercover government spy. In Trusted Hands is based on 20 years of real repair‑shop experience and turns everyday incidents into a satirical, story‑rich gameplay experience.

▼ Watch the full console gameplay trailer
▼ Console release date: May 7, 2026 (Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch)

🔧 About the game
In Trusted Hands is a satirical phone repair simulator with strong narrative and choice‑driven gameplay. Every device you repair can change someone’s life, and every action can trigger unexpected outcomes.

🕹️ Key features
Repair smartphones using realistic tools and diagnostics

Access customer data and uncover personal stories

Make choices that matter and influence the city’s residents

Buy phones, sell spare parts and grow your workshop income

Collaborate with a secret agent and act as an undercover technician‑spy

Experience dark humor and privacy satire about data, fear and control

See how good intentions backfire and lead to surprising consequences

🎮 Platforms
Xbox One
Xbox Series X|S
PlayStation 4
PlayStation 5
Nintendo Switch

In Trusted Hands – console release on May 7, 2026.
